title: elder-plinius/T3MP3ST
claim: elder-plinius/T3MP3ST — autonomous red teaming platform; multi-agent offensive-security meta-harness
why_good: T3MP3ST is an autonomous red teaming platform that allows your existing AI coding agent to perform offensive security tasks, executing the full kill chain from reconnaissance to reporting without requiring new API keys or cloud services.
value: Security teams and ethical hackers pay for T3MP3ST to enhance their vulnerability assessment capabilities using their existing AI tools without incurring extra costs.
risk: T3MP3ST may struggle against established security firms that offer comprehensive, integrated solutions with extensive support and training.
does: T3MP3ST is an autonomous red teaming platform that allows your existing AI coding agent to perform offensive security tasks, executing the full kill chain from reconnaissance to reporting without requiring new API keys or cloud services.
edge: Its unique keyless operation means you can utilize your current AI agent without additional costs or configurations.
why_use: Choose T3MP3ST for its reproducible claims and transparent status reporting, ensuring you know exactly what works and what doesn't.
hook: Transform your AI coding agent into a zero-day hunting machine with T3MP3ST.
